Description:
Functional Features:This is the Create® 3 mobile robot platform developed by iRobot, designed for robotics education, research, and algorithm development. Its functional features include differential drive, autonomous navigation, obstacle detection, and full ROS 2 support. It is ideal for university courses, SLAM experiments, path planning research, and multi-robot simulations. With open APIs and sensor integration options, Create 3 enables flexible customization and is widely used as a foundational platform for indoor autonomous mobility tasks. While not built for industrial payloads, it excels in lightweight, educational, and prototyping applications.
Visual Features:Visually, the robot features a classic circular form with a dark gray and black color scheme. The top is slightly raised, housing sensor modules and control buttons. The chassis is made of high-strength plastic with a matte finish, offering durability and scratch resistance. A soft bumper ring surrounds the edge for collision detection and protection. Its compact, low-profile design allows agile movement in tight spaces, reflecting a practical, extensible, and education-friendly aesthetic.

Functional Features:This is a typical industrial four-wheeled dolly, designed for material handling and short-distance transport tasks. Its functional features include a simple structure, strong load-bearing capacity, and flexible maneuverability, making it suitable for warehouses, production lines, and distribution centers. It can be manually operated or serve as a mobile platform for automated systems such as AGVs or robotic arms, used to carry pallets, containers, or components. In simulation environments, it is often used as an interactive object for testing path planning, obstacle avoidance, grasping, and stacking algorithms, contributing to realistic industrial logistics scenarios.
Visual Features:Visually, the dolly features a striking industrial blue finish for enhanced visibility in workspaces. The frame is a rectangular metal structure with corner loops or stacking guides for securing loads or nesting multiple units. It is equipped with four swivel caster wheelsmetal-framed with rubber or polyurethane treadsfor smooth and agile movement. The body is made of steel or aluminum alloy, with a coated surface that offers durability and corrosion resistance. The overall design emphasizes practicality, stability, and long-term durability under frequent use.

Functional Features:This object is a manual hydraulic pallet truck (commonly known as a pallet jack). Its core function is to realize short-distance transfer of palletized goods through a manual hydraulic lifting mechanism. It requires no electric drive, with labor-saving and flexible operation. The forks can accurately fit standard industrial pallets, efficiently completing operations such as cargo loading and unloading, warehouse turnover, and station shifting, greatly reducing the labor intensity and safety risks of manual handling and improving logistics circulation efficiency. It is widely used in scenarios including warehousing and logistics centers, factory production workshops, supermarket warehouses, express sorting centers, and wholesale markets, featuring a sturdy structure, strong load capacity, convenient maintenance and wide adaptability.
Visual Features:Visually, the main body adopts highly recognizable industrial bright yellow coating, matched with a black ergonomic ring-shaped control handle, load-bearing wheels and hydraulic components, and the front end of the forks is designed with a chamfer for guidance. It is made of high-strength alloy steel with wear-resistant matte industrial spraying on the surface. The overall structure is compact and tough with distinct industrial attributes, and the black grid background of 3D modeling highlights its digital asset attribute.
